## 1. `/new` 的 bug

已修复。根因是 `handleMessage()` 中优先级排序错误 — Trip 活跃态分流跑在内置指令之前，导致 `/new` 被路由给了 trip agent。

## 2. 架构：Trip / 常规对话 / 快捷指令如何区分

当前修复后的优先级顺序：

```
第0优先（无论 trip 状态如何都响应）
  ├── /new /help /session /task /status   ← 系统级指令
  │
第1优先：Trip 结束指令                      ← "行程结束"等关键词
  │
第2优先：Trip 活跃态分流                     ← 已有 trip 会话时
  │
第3优先：Trip 新建                           ← 匹配 trip 关键词且非 / 开头
  │
然后：/tasks /log / 快速存档 / 远程终端 / 权限审批
  │
最后：常规 Claude 对话
```

oc_44ba0d81afa9189a67ef99d0bce1124d\u000.sessionSummary: The user asked whether their three "boot" instances share a single claudetalk instance. Investigation of systemd services (`claudetalk.service`, `claudetalk-twin.service`, `claudetalk-trip.service`) and the config file (`.claudetalk.json`) confirmed they are three independent Node.js processes — all running the same `dist/cli.js` with different `--profile` flags (`default`, `twin`, `trip`), each bound to a separate Feishu app with its own appId/secret, PID file, and session namespace. They share the same codebase and feishu-bridge but operate as separate bot identities in Feishu groups.
